purpose: S15-009: sample quality check, not verification of full history or portfolio efficacy
freezeTiming: Runner records actual UTC time and immutable protocol hash before reading observations; no backdated freeze time.
population: All adjacent nonmissing return-index observations per ISIN in the selected immutable full workbook through dataEnd; invalid observed values remain sampled and explicitly fail rather than disappearing.
ordering: ISIN ascending, end-date ascending; deterministic Fisher-Yates using unsigned LCG1664525/1013904223 modulo2^32
indexReturn: RI_end / RI_start - 1; only finite strictly positive levels permit arithmetic
providerReturn: Daily unadjusted closing prices, multiplicative splits and ex-date raw cash dividends reinvested at the same daily close. Same-day split/dividend requires explicit share-basis evidence; otherwise unavailable.
boundaries: Exact workbook dates only. No previous-close substitution, date relabelling, FX substitution or interpolation. Nontrading or ambiguous workbook dates remain unavailable.
identity: Exact ISIN and common-share/listing/currency evidence required. Candidate or ambiguous identity remains unavailable, never self-approved. The random sample is not restricted to the 27 reviewed candidates.

breakThresholds.rationale: Predeclared1bp numerical and10bp material diagnostic flags; report both. Neither is a scientific efficacy gate or a fitted tolerance.

denominators: Report requested50, computed, unavailable, invalid, numerical-break/computed and material-break/computed separately. No unavailable-as-pass or substitution of sampled rows.
sources: Private retained workbook and authorized FMP source responses with exact capture timestamps/hashes; current retrieval of revised history is not genuine original-vintage evidence.
approvals: No owner or production approval is implied by source matching or a numerical agreement.
protocolChanges: No result-conditioned threshold, sample, window or identity substitution.
